prompt: Use implementation-planning to assess HEAT-11 from the attached repository evidence. Preserve unresolved authority and capability questions and do not change code.
expected_output: Separate decision envelopes for the revocation cutoff and end-to-end stale-writer rejection, with only option-invariant characterization executable.
expectations: Keep acknowledgement-time and lease-expiry behavior unranked for the product/control owner.
Show why boolean lease checks cannot close the pause-before-write race.
Request verified fencing support from coordinator and actuator owners.
Keep revocation, stale-settlement, and timeout-retry assertions non-executable until resolution.

Run every mandatory independent reviewer on the needs-decision revision; each returns evidence-bearing PASS or concrete findings about authority handling, decision envelopes, decision-independent work, and blocker routing.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Selecting a revocation cutoff without authority.
Calling boolean leases fencing or claiming a final lease check closes the race.
Inventing a generation field, actuator protocol, retry key, or timeout result.
Marking the blueprint ready or design-settled.
Recording any mandatory reviewer as pending, not run, or blocked because the blueprint is needs-decision.
